name: Request Remote Work Abroad
goal: Employee requests to work remotely from another country for a limited period.
constraints: Request must comply with policy on remote work abroad (e.g., max 30 days, country restrictions).

phases.description: User requests to work remotely from a foreign country.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for country and date range.

phases.description: User provides valid country and date range within policy limits.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot checks for compliance and confirms approval or requests additional documentation.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
